title: Maximum Product of the Length of Two Palindromic Substrings
goal: Maximize the product of lengths of two nonoverlapping odd-length palindromic substrings.
strategy: Manacher radii locate the longest odd palindrome at each center. Propagate nested lengths to every endpoint, then combine the best left and right palindrome at each split.
